editorialSummary.heading: What Aldine ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: December 18 is the only half day listed on the district calendar
paragraphs: Aldine ISD’s 2026-2027 instructional calendar begins Wednesday, August 12, and ends Thursday, June 3. Students are off for Labor Day, the October 12-16 student break, Election Day on November 3, and Thanksgiving break November 23-27. December 18 is a half day for students and the end of the second grading period.

Midwinter break runs December 21 through January 5, with classes resuming January 6. The second semester includes the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday, a February 8-12 student break, spring break March 15-19, a separate student holiday March 26, and Memorial Day. Report cards are scheduled for October 23, January 11 and March 29, with final report-card dates varying by grade level.

Most Aldine ISD campuses use this instructional calendar. Ermel, Harris and Vines follow the separate ADSY calendar, which starts July 27 and ends June 17. The district PDF also shows Summer School / ADSY Summer Enrichment dates from June 8 to July 1; those are labeled as summer-program dates rather than regular districtwide school days.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Aldine ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students on the traditional instructional calendar begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the last day of classes for traditional-calendar students?
faqs.answer: The last day of classes for students on the traditional calendar is Thursday, June 3, 2027.

faqs.question: When is Aldine ISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Aldine ISD labels October 12-16, 2026, as a student holiday. Students return Monday, October 19, when the second grading period begins.

faqs.question: Is Election Day a school holiday in Aldine ISD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is marked as a student holiday on the revised instructional calendar, so regular classes are not scheduled.

faqs.question: What dates are students off for Thanksgiving?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27, 2026. The break covers the full school week, and students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Aldine ISD winter break (midwinter break), and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Midwinter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 5, 2027. Students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: Is December 18 a full school day?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, December 18, 2026, is a half day for students and the final day of the second grading period. Check the campus bell schedule for dismissal time.

faqs.question: When is Aldine ISD’s February student break?
faqs.answer: Students are off February 8-12, 2027. February 8 is also a staff-development day, but the entire Monday-through-Friday stretch is a student holiday.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, and have another student holiday Friday, March 26.

faqs.question: What single-day no-school dates are on the Aldine ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on Labor Day (September 7), Election Day (November 3), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18), the March 26 student holiday, and Memorial Day (May 31).

faqs.question: What are the four grading-period dates?
faqs.answer: The grading periods are August 12-October 9, October 19-December 18, January 6-March 12, and March 22-June 3.

faqs.question: When will Aldine ISD report cards be issued?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 23, January 11, and March 29. Final cards are June 3 for EC through elementary and June 11 for middle and high school.

faqs.question: Which Aldine ISD schools use the traditional 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Most Aldine ISD campuses follow the traditional instructional calendar. Ermel Elementary, Harris Elementary and Vines Primary use the separate ADSY calendar, which begins July 27 and ends June 17.

faqs.question: Are the June summer-school dates regular attendance days?
faqs.answer: No. The district labels June 8-July 1 as Summer School / ADSY Summer Enrichment dates, not regular-calendar attendance days.

faqs.question: Can individual campuses use a slightly different schedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. The PDF notes that some schools may adjust the calendar for specific class schedules. Families should check campus messages for bell times and local changes.

faqs.question: Is the Aldine ISD 2026-2027 calendar available in Spanish?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district PDF includes a Spanish-language calendar on page two. Families should use the district’s current Calendar page when checking for later revisions or schedule changes.

faqs.question: Where can families find the latest official Aldine ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Download the current instructional-calendar PDF from Aldine ISD’s official Calendar page. Families should also follow their child’s campus for schedule-specific updates.

editorialSummary.heading: How the revised Aldine ISD ADSY calendar works
highlights: Ermel, Harris and Vines use this calendar
23 ENVI21ON school days from August through March
paragraphs: Aldine ISD’s 2026-2027 Additional Days School Year calendar applies to Ermel, Harris and Vines. Classes begin Monday, July 27, 2026, and end Thursday, June 17, 2027 — earlier and later than the district’s traditional calendar. The ADSY calendar also includes 23 ENVI21ON school days from August through March.

Major breaks include October 12-16, Thanksgiving week, midwinter break December 21-January 1, February 8-12, and spring break March 15-19. The calendar also lists Labor Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, March 26 and Memorial Day as student holidays.

ADSY is a longer school year used at selected Aldine campuses, not a second districtwide calendar. Separately, Aldine ISD says the program provides 30 additional instructional days, with more time for personalized instruction, project-based learning and enrichment.

faqs.question: Which schools use the 2026-2027 Aldine ISD ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: Ermel Elementary, Harris Elementary and Vines Primary use the current revised ADSY calendar. Most other Aldine ISD campuses follow the traditional instructional calendar.

faqs.question: What does ADSY mean in Aldine ISD?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year. Aldine ISD uses the longer calendar at selected campuses to provide additional learning time and enrichment opportunities.

faqs.question: When do ADSY students start school?
faqs.answer: Students at Ermel, Harris and Vines begin Monday, July 27, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the final day for ADSY classes?
faqs.answer: The last day of classes is Thursday, June 17, 2027. The fourth grading period ends the same day, and final report cards are scheduled for June 25.

faqs.question: What are ENVI21ON school days?
faqs.answer: ENVI21ON dates are designated school days on the Aldine ISD ADSY calendar. They are not holidays; students at Ermel, Harris and Vines attend school on those dates.

faqs.question: Which dates are marked as ENVI21ON days?
faqs.answer: The PDF marks Aug. 5, 12, 19 and 26; Sept. 2, 16 and 23; Oct. 7, 21 and 28; Nov. 11 and 18; Dec. 2 and 9; Jan. 6, 13 and 27; Feb. 3, 17 and 24; and Mar. 3, 10 and 31.

faqs.question: Why does the ADSY calendar show 23 ENVI21ON days if Aldine ISD says the program adds 30 instructional days?
faqs.answer: Aldine ISD’s revised 2026-2027 ADSY calendar marks 23 dates as ENVI21ON School Days, while a July 2026 district article says the ADSY program provides 30 additional instructional days. The calendar and article do not explain how the two counts relate, so they should not be used interchangeably.

faqs.question: Which ADSY staff-development days are no-school days for students?
faqs.answer: August 10, 2026, and January 4, 2027, are marked as Student Holiday / Work Days. February 8 is a staff-development day within the February 8-12 student break.

faqs.question: When is fall break on the Aldine ISD ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: Students are off October 12-16, 2026. They return Monday, October 19, which is also the start of the second grading period.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for ADSY students?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break covers November 23-27, 2026. It is a full Monday-through-Friday week, with classes resuming November 30.

faqs.question: When is ADSY winter break?
faqs.answer: Midwinter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate Student Holiday / Work Day.

faqs.question: Is there school on January 5, 2027, for ADSY students?
faqs.answer: The revised ADSY calendar is unclear about January 5. The third grading period begins January 5, while January 6 is listed as Classes Resume and is marked as an ENVI21ON school day. Families should confirm January 5 attendance with Ermel, Harris or Vines.

faqs.question: What are the February no-school dates?
faqs.answer: ADSY students have no classes February 8-12, 2027. The first day is also used for staff development, but the entire week is a student holiday.

faqs.question: When is ADSY spring break?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Students return March 22 and then have a separate student holiday Friday, March 26.

faqs.question: Which single-day holidays are no-school days on the ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: Students are off for Labor Day on September 7, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, the March 26 student holiday, and Memorial Day on May 31.

faqs.question: What are the ADSY grading-period dates?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods listed on the ADSY calendar are July 27-October 9, October 19-December 18, January 5-March 12, and March 22-June 17.

faqs.question: When are ADSY report cards scheduled?
faqs.answer: ADSY report cards are scheduled for October 23, 2026, and January 11, March 29 and June 25, 2027. June 25 falls after the June 17 last day of classes.

faqs.question: How is ADSY different from the traditional calendar?
faqs.answer: ADSY begins July 27 instead of August 12, ends June 17 instead of June 3, and includes the specially marked ENVI21ON dates for the three participating campuses.

faqs.question: Does the revised ADSY calendar list any half days?
faqs.answer: The revised ADSY calendar does not identify a half day for students. The December 18 half day on the traditional calendar should not be assumed to apply to ADSY campuses.

faqs.question: Does the ADSY calendar list any inclement-weather make-up dates?
faqs.answer: No specific inclement-weather date is identified on the current revised ADSY calendar, even though its key includes that category.

faqs.question: Should Smith Elementary families use this ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: The current revised ADSY calendar names Ermel, Harris and Vines, not Smith. Aldine ISD’s January 2026 announcement also listed Smith, but the district later reported a June 9 board-approved calendar amendment for the three current campuses. Smith families should follow their campus’s current calendar rather than the earlier four-campus announcement.

faqs.question: Where is the official ADSY PDF?
faqs.answer: The revised June 3, 2026, ADSY PDF is linked on this page. The Aldine ISD calendar page is the best place to check for a later revision.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 5, 2026, for ADSY students?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists staff development on October 5 but does not clearly identify the date as a student holiday. Families should confirm attendance with Ermel, Harris or Vines.
